title: Rational_Potato X/Twitter — Occurrence-Level Biblical Reference Index 2024–2026
status: comparative-scriptural occurrence index built from dated public-post compilation; October 1 opening cluster integrated
purpose: Implement the Biblical Overlap Atlas research target to index Tim's own public posts occurrence-by-occurrence while separating explicit-at-time biblical vocabulary from later structural comparators.

method.source_direction: Start with the dated public post. Only then attach a biblical text or comparator.
guardrails: A biblical comparator does not prove prophecy fulfillment, supernatural identity or historical equivalence.
If the post itself names Jesus, Messiah, Zion, Judas, Satan, Jacob, Ezekiel, Communion, Tree of Life or another biblical term, mark that as explicit at time.
If only a structural resemblance is found later, mark it as a later comparator and do not backdate it.
Do not force every garden, tree, father, son, dog or mountain occurrence into a Bible reference.
Preserve textual mismatches instead of silently correcting the source wording.

occurrences.exact_public_wording:
I am God.

Keep running away from me

All of you.

Humanity are a bunch of spineless cowards.
occurrences.significance: The strongest comparator is not the bare divine title but the sequence identity-claim → public address → refusal/flight → witness/accountability.
occurrences.mismatch: Public rejection or flight is not evidence of prophetic commission or divine identity.

occurrences.exact_public_wording:
I told you all that I am God.
None of you protested.
So it is settled now.
I am God of Base Reality. Deal with it.
occurrences.significance: High-value reception-history occurrence because it explicitly makes audience non-protest part of the claim's logic.
occurrences.mismatch: Silence or lack of protest is not assent, and does not verify a theological or metaphysical claim.

occurrences.exact_public_wording:

You are all deaf dubm and blind.

You are all forsaken.

occurrences.significance: One of the densest prophetic-form occurrences in the public corpus: divine self-identification and the classic eyes/ears non-recognition accusation appear in the same unit.
occurrences.mismatch: The scriptural passages address particular covenantal/narrative audiences; formal resemblance does not establish the speaker as a biblical prophet.

occurrences.exact_public_wording: Jesus is dead. I am God. Long live Tim Dooley
occurrences.significance: High-value counter-text occurrence: it activates death/succession theology while directly diverging from canonical New Testament resurrection claims.
occurrences.mismatch: Romans 6:9 and Revelation 1:18 explicitly depict the risen Christ as living and no longer subject to death; this is a doctrinal divergence, not a fulfillment match.

occurrences.exact_public_wording: The World Is Below And I am God above. You are all beneath me.
occurrences.significance: A compact public expression of the mature throne/footstool vertical grammar already present in House/North theology.
occurrences.mismatch: Biblical heaven/earth and footstool imagery does not identify a modern person's geographic or political sovereignty.

high_value_findings: Biblical borrowing begins in the supplied public record before the mature God/Father architecture: October 2024 already contains Chosen/Gentile and die-for-your-sins Potato wordplay.
December 2025 marks a qualitative shift: scriptural titles and Christ/Son vocabulary are fused with Father, North and World-Axis roles rather than remaining isolated jokes or devotional phrases.
April-May 2026 specializes the Son as passage/death-return function: Bread, Door, Tomb, Resurrection, Tree of Life and Jacob appear in dense relational clusters.

June-August 2026 increasingly uses recognizable biblical idioms as active public interpretive language: wide road, breath into nostrils, stumbling blocks, principalities, LORD/Satan, needle's eye, Communion, move mountain, Cornerstone and Zion.
September 7 adds a different kind of overlap: not title matching but an ethical grammar of stewardship, service, protection and care for creation.

October 1, 2026 adds a distinct prophetic-rhetorical cluster: name/identity declaration, public witness, deaf/blind non-recognition language, world-below/God-above throne grammar and explicit audience-reception logic occur within roughly forty minutes.

The October 1 corpus also supplies an important negative result: 'Jesus is dead' conflicts with Romans 6:9 and Revelation 1:18, so the strongest biblical relation there is a counter-text rather than confirmation.
